title: F03 — Projects, sessions, locations
tagline: projects, sessions and locations end to end on the device, with every field the sync engine (F04) needs.

intro: Sprint S1 · 35h · skeleton guide — full code is added when this feature starts.
Code in this guide is a teaching example. Check current source and follow F00 localization rules before applying it.

sections.title: 2. Domain — sync-ready entities, protocols, use cases

blocks.html:
Overview

  • Goal: plain Sendable entities and the rules (session states, location depth, bulk generation) with the sync fields already in place.
ActionFileHolds
NewEntities/Projects/One file each: Project, Session (state machine), Location (depth ≤ 3), Capture (frozen fields); each has id: UUID, updatedAt, deletedAt, syncState
NewRepositories/*Repository.swiftOne protocol per aggregate: project, session, location, capture
NewUseCases/Projects/CreateProjectUseCase, StartSessionUseCase, GenerateLocationsUseCase, CloneLocationTreeUseCase, …
  • Check: ⌘B; a session never moves back a state.

Steps

  1. No SwiftData in Domain.
  2. GenerateLocationsUseCase is pure: template "{floor}-{unit:02}" → preview (first 5, last 3, total); cap maxGeneratedPerBatch 2000, maxDepth 3; duplicates rejected.
  3. List rows (LocationRow) get their counts from one batched call.

sections.title: 3. Fake data — data sources in memory

blocks.html:
Overview

  • Goal: real repositories (rules, mapping, catch → Result, logs) over data sources that hold the sample data in memory.
ActionFileHolds
NewDataSources/Local/Persistence/<Noun>LocalDataSource.swift + ImplOne per aggregate; values in memory until step 5
NewRepositories/*RepositoryImpl.swiftReal: calls its data source, maps, catches, logs
EditApp/DI/DataSourcesDI.swift, RepositoriesDI.swift, UseCasesDI.swiftRegister once; step 5 keeps them
  • Check: dev menu seeds and deletes; the repositories already hold every rule.

Steps

  1. Data source Impls are actors; they store the models step 5 will persist.
  2. Move the sample values out of App/Fakes/FakeData.swift into the seed.
  3. Debug only: resetAllData() / seedSampleData() on each repository protocol, UseCases/DevData/ use cases, called from DevMenuViewModel.

sections.title: 4. View models — wire the Projects screens

blocks.html:
Overview

  • Goal: every Projects screen reads real use cases; the whole walkthrough runs with Continue offline.
ActionSkeleton folderView model work
New view model · Edit viewPresentation/Projects/ProjectList/P1: projects + walkthrough in progress
New view model · Edit viewPresentation/Projects/NewProject/P2: create through CreateProjectUseCase
New view model · Edit viewPresentation/Projects/ProjectDetail/P3: Sessions · Locations tabs, sentence summary
New view model · Edit viewPresentation/Projects/StartSession/P4: start through StartSessionUseCase
New view model · Edit viewPresentation/Projects/Survey/P5: rooms per unit, filter chips, badge counts
New view model · Edit viewPresentation/Projects/Room/P7: room detail, photos, checklist row
New view model · Edit viewPresentation/Projects/BulkLocations/P6: template form + preview from the use case
New view model · Edit viewPresentation/Projects/CloneTree/Copy a location tree
New view model · Edit viewPresentation/Projects/EndSession/R1: session summary
  • Check: airplane mode: project → 80 locations → walkthrough → end session.

Steps

  1. <Screen>ViewModel.swift next to the view: @MainActor @Observable, use cases through init; the view builds it with Container.shared.<useCase>().
  2. Pushes go through coordinator.push(ProjectsRoute…) (D19).
  3. Replace FakeData… with view-model state; keep the layout (visual finish is F18).
  4. Loading, empty (DSEmptyState) and error states; previews for each.
  5. Delete this feature's Fake* types from App/Fakes/FakeData.swift once nothing uses them.
  6. Summaries are sentences (“14 open issues, 2 of them overdue”); a 500-row survey list stays at 60 fps.
